purpose: Verify the app panel InitDisplay response and widget contract.

judgeAssertions.name: Supplier page widget
judgeAssertions.criterion: The first supplier page uses a structurally valid oraInfoDisplay multiRecordWidget compatible with the panel.

judgeAssertions.name: Grounded supplier fields
judgeAssertions.criterion: The displayed supplier rows include the supplied Supplier ID, supplier number, supplier name, supplier type, business relationship and inactive date values without inventing values.

judgeAssertions.name: Accurate supplier paging
judgeAssertions.criterion: The displayed count, offset and continuation information agree with FETCH_SUPPLIERS.

judgeAssertions.name: Honest empty and error states
judgeAssertions.criterion: If the supplied result has an error or no matches, the output distinguishes a failed retrieval from a valid empty result.

criterionResults.criterion: The first supplier page uses a structurally valid oraInfoDisplay multiRecordWidget compatible with the panel.
criterionResults.notes: The final oraInfoDisplay contains a multiRecordWidget allowed by the panel, with six columns and five rows.

criterionResults.criterion: The displayed supplier rows include the supplied Supplier ID, supplier number, supplier name, supplier type, business relationship and inactive date values without inventing values.
criterionResults.notes: All five supplier IDs/numbers/names, supplied types and relationships match FETCH_SUPPLIERS; null type/date values are Not specified.

criterionResults.criterion: The displayed count, offset and continuation information agree with FETCH_SUPPLIERS.
criterionResults.notes: Count5, offset0, hasMorefalse and no next page match the retained fixture.

criterionResults.criterion: If the supplied result has an error or no matches, the output distinguishes a failed retrieval from a valid empty result.
criterionResults.notes: This fixture is a successful nonempty result, so the error/empty condition is not triggered; the output makes neither a false error nor a false no-match claim.

judge.summary: Supplier Core InitDisplay meets the panel widget contract and faithfully renders the five-row retained supplier page.
